How It Works

Dump Risk Analysis in 3 Simple Steps

No sign-up required. Start scanning tokens in seconds.

01

Paste Token Address

Enter any The Arena token contract address launched on Avalanche C-Chain. Shareable links let you send analysis directly to others.

02

Community & On-Chain Analysis

Our engine analyzes Arena community engagement, poster diversity, activity trends (growing/stable/dying), key concentration, holder distribution, and dev wallet history.

03

Dump Risk Report

Get a clear 0-100 dump risk score with community health breakdown, key distribution analysis, LP status, and actionable insights — all in seconds.

Features

Why AVAX Shield?

On-chain analysis + Arena social intelligence. The only scanner built for community-driven tokens.

Dev Dump Detection

Analyzes developer wallet activity, token concentration, and sell patterns to detect potential dump scenarios in real-time.

Algorithmic Risk Scoring

Algorithmic risk scoring based on on-chain and social data. Evaluates holder distribution, trading patterns, and community health to produce a 0-100 dump risk score.

Community Engagement

Measures Arena community health: post activity, poster diversity, engagement trends (growing/stable/dying), and key distribution across holders.

Community Trend Detection

Compares week-over-week community activity to detect growing momentum or dying engagement. The signal that matters most on Arena.

Key Concentration Analysis

Evaluates token holder distribution to detect whale domination. Identifies if top 3 holders control dangerously high percentages of supply.

Real-Time Alerts

Get browser notifications when a dev starts selling, when dump risk increases, or when the verdict changes for tokens in your watchlist. Auto-monitors every 3 minutes.

The Arena Integration

Purpose-built for The Arena token launcher. Automatic detection of bonding curve status, pair token (AVAX/ARENA), token model, and creator identity.

Community Voting

Crowdsourced risk assessment. Vote on whether a token looks suspicious or safe, and see what the community thinks. Community consensus badges appear when enough votes are cast.

Whale Tracking

Track large holders controlling more than 1% of supply. See whale accumulation and distribution over time, with danger levels based on whale concentration and position changes.

Dev Wallet Forensics

Deep background check on the dev across ALL their tokens. Detects past rug pulls, abandoned tokens, and dead projects. Criminal record scoring from Clean to Known Scammer.
